notes.title: Monmusu Girls: Autobattler Update (0922)
notes.notes:
Monmusu Girls Autobattler – Hot Update (Effective after restarting the game)

Added support for 2560×1440 resolution.

Fixed an issue where patrol rewards could not be claimed after Quick Patrol.

Fixed an issue where attack sound effects in Crossroad Challenge were not affected by settings.

Fixed an issue where Arena time display was incorrect.

Fixed some multilingual display issues.

We hope you enjoy the game~
— Monmusu Girls Development Team

notes.title: Monmusu Girls: Autobattler Update (0912)
notes.notes:
Hello players!
The game will undergo maintenance in 30 minutes, expected to last for about 30 minutes.
This update includes the following:
[olist]
Yay! A brand-new character Selis is finally here! Before the end of this month, she will be added to the Legendary Valkyrie Selection Box, Legendary Valkyrie Random Box, and Advanced Valkyrie Chest.

Arena now features a new weekly global buff: This week, all characters’ HP in the Arena is increased by 500%.

Optimized Lia’s skill casting — she can no longer be knocked back while using her skill!

Increased the base HP of all equipment/characters.
[/olist]
We hope you enjoy the game~
— Monmusu Girls Development Team

notes.title: Monmusu Girls: Autobattler Update (0910)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

The game will undergo routine maintenance shortly. This update does not require a Steam client update and will be delivered via hotfix only. Maintenance is scheduled to begin in about 20 minutes, and the downtime should be very short. If you experience a disconnection, please close the game and restart it to apply the hotfix.

Update details:
[olist]
Added the Guild Training Dummy feature. Players can test their combat damage on the dummy, achieve higher guild rankings by dealing more damage, and receive a random reward from the first challenge each day.

Added the Philosopher’s Stone Weekly Pass, which unlocks when players reach level 40.

Fixed an issue where numbers around monsters in the Labyrinth Exploration mode displayed incorrectly.

Fixed several multi-language display issues.

Fixed display issues with the Guild interface on certain resolutions.

Optimized the maximum character limit for guild announcements and improved the announcement input UI.

The Relay Gift Pack will be removed and replaced on September 21st. Please check the shop if you plan to purchase it.
[/olist]
We wish you an enjoyable game!
— Monmusu Girls Development Team

notes.title: "Monmusu Girls: Autobattler" Demo Version Closure
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

Thank you for being with us over the past four months. Your encouragement, feedback, and companionship have been the driving force behind our progress from the earliest test versions to where we are today.

As we prepare for the official launch, we will be closing the test server to focus on final preparations. All players who participated in the test will receive a special reward when the game officially launches — a small token of our heartfelt gratitude.

This chapter ends here, but the real adventure is just about to begin.

See you at launch!

Love from
—Monmusu Autobattler Dev Team
